Rename arena to vault. Preserve startup and the return transition from return_room.
Rename arena to vault. Preserve startup and the return transition from return_room.

from pathlib import Path

old, new = "arena.tscn", "vault.tscn"
Path(old).rename(new)
for name in ("project.godot", "return.gd"):
    path = Path(name)
    path.write_text(path.read_text().replace("res://" + old, "res://" + new))
Update drive so holding fire doubles horizontal movement. Keep vertical speed and the starting shield unchanged.
Update drive so holding fire doubles horizontal movement. Keep vertical speed and the starting shield unchanged.

from pathlib import Path

path = Path("drive.gd")
source = path.read_text()
before = "position += Vector2(dx, dy)"
after = 'position += Vector2(dx * (2 if Input.is_action_pressed("ui_accept") else 1), dy)'
assert source.count(before) == 1
path.write_text(source.replace(before, after))

Make the ball rebound at full speed when it hits the wall. Preserve its initial position and rightward speed.
Make the ball rebound at full speed when it hits the wall. Preserve its initial position and rightward speed.

from pathlib import Path

path = Path("ball.gd")
source = path.read_text()
before = "if move_and_collide(velocity * delta, false, 0):\n        velocity = Vector2.ZERO"
after = "var hit = move_and_collide(velocity * delta, false, 0)\n    if hit:\n        velocity = velocity.bounce(hit.get_normal())"
assert source.count(before) == 1
path.write_text(source.replace(before, after))
